source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Mortarion can use **[Inflamed Reprisal](vsdata:ability/death-guard.mortarion.inflamed-reprisal)** in the opposing [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) when an enemy attacks one **DEATH GUARD** unit no farther than 6″ from him. Once the attacker is done, its target can return fire under your own Shooting phase rules. Worsen its Ballistic Skill by 1 for the return fire. The attacker is its sole permitted target and must be eligible for its shots.

typedMechanics.recipient: one Death Guard unit targeted by the enemy attack
typedMechanics.reaction: recipient shoots as in own Shooting phase
